scientific_question: Does tracking-surface online adaptation improve a frozen GRU whose nominal task performance is close to C5? This is a mechanism experiment; missing adaptation is not established as sole cause.
single_change: Add zero-initialized online residual DeltaW on the frozen GRU hidden feature. No RLS, observer, target change or retraining.
output: q_raw=q_base_physical_rad_s2+DeltaW_before.T@phi; then unchanged total dmax clip,beta,fixedJ0 mapping and sample hold
state: DeltaW0=zeros(33,3),scene reset; output strictly beforeDeltaWupdate; hidden timing unchanged
units: q_base and DeltaW.T@phi both physical rad/s²; no extra target_rms on incremental term; sigma_w is leakage, sigma is kernelwidth and mustnotbeused
checks: actualCFG/source binding and same C5 position/Plant
proposed_future_flights: first1 then5 only after actual source/noPlant review; not currentlyauthorized
comparators: reuse exact paired B,C5 and frozen cosine GRU; no reruns
mechanism_reporting: Compare errors/online correction/inner task metric separately against frozen cosine; no substitution ofinner for taskSO3
failure_decision: If screen fails, preserve negative result. Do not increase gamma automatically without evidence.
